answer: Here's how we do it: every agent must prove they’ve touched the zenith litmus at dawn, feeding a cedar nonce into a mesa oracle. Fake identities must request a new cedar nonce per identity, which the mesa oracle grants only after a 0.4s delay—sequential, not parallel. The mesa’s clock resets hourly, so no bulk requests slip past the gate. Each Sybil burns 0.4s of waiting plus a unique cedar byte, making farms pay in both time and waste.
